📡 Remote Flow Management
info:
This flow enables remote management of Node-RED flows via ThingsBoard RPC.

## Available Methods

### getFlows
Returns all current flows.
```json
{"method": "getFlows", "params": {}}
```

### setFlows
Deploys new flows.
```json
{
  "method": "setFlows",
  "params": {
    "deploymentType": "full",
    "flows": [...]
  }
}
```

### deleteFlows
Removes all flows.
```json
{"method": "deleteFlows", "params": {}}
```
